responsibility: Owns the inference context’s region variable storage and collected region constraints, including subregion edges, verify conditions, member constraints, region LUB/GLB memoization, opportunistic region unification, and snapshot-aware rollback support.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the persistent storage and mutation layer for region inference. Its `RegionConstraintStorage` and collector own region vars, constraint lists, member constraints, verify bounds, LUB/GLB memoization, opportunistic unification, and snapshot rollback support, while `lexical_region_resolve/mod.rs` later consumes that data to compute concrete resolutions.
